parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The alert type.

*   Set the value to **sensitiveFile**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-image-event-operation-condition --event-type sensitiveFile --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeImageEventOperationCondition --region cn-hangzhou --EventType sensitiveFile --Lang zh
